arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'bookings' AS tbl, json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference)) AS rows FROM bookings UNION ALL SELECT 'charges',json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',charge_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step)) FROM charges UNION ALL SELECT 'events',json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox UNION ALL SELECT 'cancellations',json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_group_array(json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_group_array(json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step)) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'pending' AS tbl,json_group_array(json_object('booking',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'reference',b.client_reference,'charge',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'charge_step',c.created_step,'cancel',e.event_id)) AS rows FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_group_array(json_object('id',o.event_id,'booking',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'attempts',o.attempts,'actual_flight',b.flight_id,'actual_passenger',b.passenger_id,'booking_status',b.status)) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancels',json_group_array(json_object('request',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',value)) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_group_array(json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step)) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'incident_bookings' AS tbl,json_group_array(json_object('booking',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'status',b.status,'reference',b.client_reference,'charge',c.charge_id,'state',c.state,'key',c.idempotency_key,'cancel',e.event_id)) AS rows FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.confirmed_at IS NULL OR c.created_step=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'cancels',json_group_array(json_object('request',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',value)) FROM service_config

SELECT 'pending' AS tbl,json_group_array(json_object('booking',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'charge',c.charge_id,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step,'key',c.idempotency_key)) AS rows FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'refunds',json_group_array(json_object('booking',booking_id,'charge',charge_id,'amount',amount_cents,'step',created_step)) FROM refunds UNION ALL SELECT 'cancels',json_group_array(json_object('request',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'recent_payment',json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'path',path,'status',status,'message',message)) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE service='payment' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20) UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',value)) FROM service_config
